verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a Multi-session feature for starting multiple agents in parallel on the same project, which covers the parallel-execution half of the story. Nothing shows these sessions are framed as competing attempts at one task, or that there is any side-by-side comparison or select-a-winner flow. missing for 10: isolation of attempts (e.g. separate worktrees or branches), a built-in diff or comparison of attempt results, a mechanism to choose and apply one attempt, in-depth docs beyond a marketing feature line, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one

citations.quote: Start multiple agents in parallel on the same project
